§5.2: source-formed State descriptors allocate exact step state, declaration-order locations, image regions, table and B frames; Frames has exactly B indices 0..B-1 and matching State identities. Run catalog step for each frame, commit success payload / first fault / step exhaustion, reverse frames then initialization and allocations. P satisfies 2^P>N; Q is exact source frame width; F>=4. Explicit row/successor templates contain source rows, never an opaque dispatcher.

§4.5 qinplace: t=qalloc any N; f=qalloc any F; oracle_call G; qexch x t; oracle_call H; qfree t; qfree f, exactly in this order (K28). G/H are one-element K22 source-call adapters with wire[N],wire[N],wire[F] formals for x,t,f: each body is the corresponding linked oracle call, capturing the exact ins, mem, args and token actuals (K24/K26), never a supplied decomposition. N/F and both interfaces match §4.5; a covering inverse-pair certificate is required before effects. All call/exchange gates inherit E; allocations/releases are unconditional. The private instruction allocations are not recipe scratch. The adjoint swaps G/H with all captures retained.
